title: Report writers and the POV planner: Word, PDF, Excel, CSV and Markdown exports, POV revision, import, Prove it, files and secrets

checks.what: Every Word output is opened: each XML part parsed, text read back; markup, XML-unsafe characters and bidi controls are inert
Every PDF output is walked: xref offsets, stream lengths, ASCII content, balanced and correctly escaped string literals, document info
Every workbook is unzipped and each part parsed; no cell is a formula; formula-looking text quoted; Excel cell cap respected
Oracle table of formula triggers and plain numbers; written CSV parses back neutralised, header included
Leading block markers, links, images, HTML and pipes in values stay inert; block-marker check is linear
CJK and RTL text round-trips in Word and Excel and shows as visible '?' in PDF; lone surrogates and controls never fail an export
Long tokens wrap within margins; long headings and footers stay on the page
Large workbooks, plan PDFs (page breaks, repeated headers) and the check cap
Stale, boolean, string and float revisions are refused with 409 and nothing is saved
Untrusted import: size, depth, format, tenant, start time, verdict and counts provenance
Prove it replaces its last verdict, keeps notes, bumps the revision; a page cannot forge a verdict or a note author
POV folder 0700; POV, lock and templates files 0600
POV opens, imports and reports only for its own tenant (409 otherwise)
A pasted secret is absent from the view, export, PDF and Word report; system evidence masked
Odd posted types never give a 500 from the report writers

findings.title: An Excel cell holding formula-looking text at the length cap was 32,768 characters (and astral text over Excel's UTF-16 limit), so Excel reported the workbook damaged
findings.fix: Cap after the formula quote and count UTF-16 units

findings.title: A PDF heading taller than a page was drawn below the page edge (text lost)
findings.fix: Break a heading across pages line by line

findings.title: A PDF table with no columns crashed the export (ValueError)
findings.fix: Skip a table with no columns

findings.title: PDF document title, author and subject kept bidi overrides and control characters (title spoofing in the reader's window bar)
findings.fix: Drop controls and show bidi controls as U+FFFD in the document information

findings.title: The PDF footer was shortened one character at a time with a full width sum each step: quadratic per page for a long title
findings.fix: Cut the footer in one linear pass

findings.title: Markdown exports: a tenant value starting with '# ', '- ', '1. ' or '---' became a heading, list item or rule (also inside a '- {name}' bullet)
findings.fix: md_safe.text escapes a leading block marker

findings.title: md_safe.url accepted a link target holding '|', which splits a Markdown table row
findings.fix: Refuse '|' in a link target; show it as text

findings.title: Word report: posted metadata that is not text (a number, list or object), a check without status or a null detail made /api/report/docx fail with a 500
findings.fix: Normalise every posted check field and metadata value to text

findings.title: Word report: the 'Report generated ... UTC' line used local time
findings.fix: Use UTC from an injectable clock

findings.title: POV: a page could set or change who wrote a note and when by re-sending a stored note id with another author
findings.fix: Note author and time are set by the app: kept when unchanged, the editor's when edited

findings.title: POV: a page note reusing a Prove it verdict's id produced duplicate evidence ids
findings.fix: A note that reuses another item's id gets its own id

findings.title: POV import: created_at was any text, so a file could set a future start and hide every change made during the POV from the customer report
findings.fix: An imported start must be a real past time; stored in UTC

findings.title: POV: Prove it verdicts and Insights counts were stored without masking the sign-in secrets (notes and edits were masked)
findings.fix: Mask system evidence and counts before they are kept

findings.title: POV import: Insights counts from a file were shown in the report as if this app had read them (verdicts were already marked imported)
findings.fix: Mark imported counts and say so in the report

findings.title: POV: a templates.json entry with an unknown vertical or odd criteria raised KeyError (500) when a POV started from it
findings.fix: Validate a stored template before a POV starts from it

findings.title: /api/report/docx returns the exception type and text to the browser on a failed build
findings.fix: /api/report/docx and the bypass report's Word export answer one plain sentence (WORD_REPORT_FAILED); the traceback stays in the server log. Also ...::test_a_failed_bypass_word_export_returns_plain_words_not_the_exception

findings.title: tools/quality_score.py refuses the files, coverage and proposed_patch keys that the wave-6 findings schema asks for
findings.fix: Resolved at integration (bde03b1: files, coverage, notes, baseline, proposed_patch keys); completed here: multi-line patches, coverage context, finding files, commit lists
